reason: A DSH Web plugin marketplace that catalogs community plugins, discovers repositories through GitHub, verifies package manifests, and installs eligible plugins into the web profile.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供插件市场，用于浏览、搜索、校验并安装社区插件。
summaries.en: Provides a DSH Web plugin marketplace for browsing, searching, verifying, and installing community plugins.

capabilities: Discovers plugins from a curated catalog and GitHub topic search
Fetches GitHub repository metadata and star counts
Queues and installs community plugins into the DSH web profile
Invokes the official dsh plugin CLI and writes store-owned cache and backup files
